definitions.explanation: A genre of fiction involving magic, mythical creatures, and imaginary worlds. Also refers to works in this genre.
An unrealistic or fanciful idea or mental image, often implying wishful thinking.

examples.japanese: ファンタジー⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ファンタジー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This movie is said to be a masterpiece of fantasy.

examples.english: Many people have fantasies about country life, but reality is harsh.

notes:
Borrowed from English "fantasy." Most commonly used for the fiction genre, but also for unrealistic dreams or ideas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ファンタジー⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (fantasy novel)
- ファンタジー⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (fantasy film)
- ファンタジー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (fantasy world)
- ファンタジー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (to harbor a fantasy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ファンタジー: the genre or an unrealistic dream/vision
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧: daydream, imagination (more neutral, not necessarily unrealistic)
- ⟦{幻想|げんそう}→幻想：06753_gensou⟧: illusion, vision (often literary; can imply something misleading)
